Headquartered in Chennai, Hinduja Tech has pioneered automotive product co-development using its unique ‘Frugal EngiNEARing Paradigm’ with a strong focus on 'zero-based design to cost process' and delivered award-winning programs. Focused on the automotive industry, Hinduja Tech’s digital technologies services & solution division is a co-innovation partner for SAP/ERP services and offers enterprise mobility services, full stack IT development, testing, and maintenance using its own agile development methodology and accelerators. Our 100+ client list includes Top Global Auto OEMs, leading disruptive and emerging OEMs, & Global Tiers in Asia, North America, Europe and the Middle East.
